messages:
maria_ml: FYI nightly eval alert: longform-summarization promptset dropped from 92.3% to 76.8% on canary of rdx-3.1-q4f (streaming+batching). Noticed at 03:12 UTC.

josh_research: repro steps?

maria_ml: quick repro attached -> run locally with packing enabled + streaming mode. Code:
```
python -m rinf.eval --model rdx-3.1-q4f --mode streaming --batch-sizes 1,4 --prompts tests/longform/*.json
```
Responses truncate or hallucinate after reflecting a shifted entity.

kai_infra: saw correlation in edge logs: attention_mask_mismatch in cuda-kernel logs at the same window. sample log:
```
[03:13:42] kernel: attention_mask::bit_order=inv seq_len=4096 batch=4
```

sana_prod: can we rollback the canary? Rollout is at ~3% traffic.

devops_bot: deploy rdx-3.0 -> rollback triggered by sana_prod at 03:20 UTC

maria_ml: root cause summary: mask bit-order inversion introduced by new packer in q4f runtime. Under streaming with dynamic padding the BOS alignment shifted, effectively flipping attention targets for tokens after pad compaction. Only reproduces for packed 4-bit path + streaming batching.

ben_research: ok is this quant-only? does fp16 or bf16 path show it?

maria_ml: tested: rdx-3.1-fp16 OK; rdx-3.1-q4f BAD. So yes quant & packer change.

maria_ml: mitigations:
1) rollback canary -> done
2) blockstreaming + q4f in gating rules until patch
3) add unit test that asserts mask parity for packed batches
4) patch packer to preserve bit-order and add CI kernel tests
5) add nightly eval probe specifically combining streaming+packing+longform

Assigns: kai_infra -> rollback & gating (in progress). ben_research -> unit test. josh_research -> help write repro harness. I'll own kernel patch.

kai_infra: rolling rollback confirmed, canary traffic moved back to rdx-3.0. Added temporary gating flag: infra.gating.disable_stream_q4f=true

devops_bot: rollback complete at 03:28 UTC, canary reduced to 0.3%

josh_research: added repro harness in ci/tests/stream_pack_repro.py and a short failing test; pushing PR

maria_ml: thanks. I'll open a root-cause PR with logs + microbench results. Will add timeline and ETA for patch. Closing thread but will update once kernel PR lands. :thumbsup:
